description: This file defines the 'Comment' class within the Opencart's Catalog Controller namespace for CMS comments. It contains methods for listing, adding, replying to, and managing comments related to articles or blog posts, including handling pagination, sorting, filtering, and captcha verification.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS comments, including listing, adding, replying, and fetching comments and replies with complete pagination, sorting, and captcha handling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the comments page related to an article, initializes language, handles request parameters such as article_id, sorting, pagination, loads necessary models, and renders the comments view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of comments as a view output after processing the request, primarily used for AJAX calls to load comments dynamically.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares a list of comments for a specific article with pagination, sorting, and formatting, returning HTML via a view.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Handles loading and rendering a reply interface for a comment, invoking the getReplies method.

methods.name: getReplies
methods.description: Fetches and displays replies to a specific comment, with support for pagination and nested replies, returning the appropriate view.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new comment or reply to an article, including validation, spam checking, captcha verification, and updating comment ratings.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Handles voting (like/dislike) for a specific comment, including validation, rating adjustments, and response with JSON.
